Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for procurement: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use: chatbot + batch embeddings for search (customer support workloads)
- Compliance: need contract and SOC2 evidence (we can share)
- Procurement preference: will confirm if PO or corporate card is used; likely PO for enterprise purchases

Commercial / procurement questions we discussed (please confirm the answers and timeline):
1) Billing: Are you able to pay via PO and net-30 terms? If yes, we'll route to our finance flow and prep a standard MSA.
2) Marketplace: Is Acme interested in procuring via AWS Marketplace/others (they prefer marketplace if available for internal approval)?
3) Deployment: Do you want hosted (Redwood API) or dedicated capacity/private deployment? We outlined tradeoffs on the call — hosted is fastest, dedicated gives predictable throughput and isolation, private for on-prem/regulatory requirements.
4) Commits vs on-demand: Would Acme commit to a monthly GPU/TU spend (reserved capacity) for better unit pricing, or prefer on-demand usage?

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm PO vs card and whether marketplace is required (by EOD Fri if possible)
- I attach an updated Dedicated pricing/packaging PDF and a SOW draft for your procurement team to review
- If PO, Paul — can your team share any specific contracting requirements (clauses, PO template)?
- We can schedule a short call with finance/legal next week if helpful to unblock approvals

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v2.pdf (pricing tiers + commit options), SOW-draft-acme.docx (placeholder)

Thanks — I’m available Thu/Fri morning PST for quick sync.

Hi Paul / Samantha — quick technical & packaging notes to help procurement: 

- Hosted vs Dedicated: Hosted (Redwood API) requires no infra setup and is charged per-token/per-embedding; Dedicated provides reserved GPU capacity and predictable throughput. If you plan for sustained high throughput for chat + embedding, Dedicated commit tiers save ~30–45% on per-unit cost depending on tier.
- Private/on-prem: Supported via our Private offering but has longer lead time (security review + on-prem package). If you need private, we recommend starting hosted pilot and planning private in parallel.
- Billing: We support PO & net-30; our invoices accept PO numbers and we can provide the remit-to details in the MSA.
- Commit tiers: Small (monthly commit $12k), Medium ($50k), Large ($150k) — these are examples in the attached PDF and drive tiered unit pricing. Dedicated also supports burst capacity if you hit spikes.

Happy to join the finance/legal call and answer any technical questions about isolation and data handling.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
